description: This file defines composable UI components for overlaying a camera flash effect in an Android application using Jetpack Compose. It includes a CameraFlashOverlay component that displays a white flash by adjusting alpha transparency briefly to simulate a camera flash.

methods.name: CameraFlashOverlay
methods.description: A composable function that creates an overlay covering the entire screen and contains the CameraFlash component, used to simulate a camera flash effect.

methods.name: CameraFlash
methods.description: A private composable function that manages the flash animation by changing its alpha transparency temporarily based on a token.
